segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Quick one on the public pricing page refresh. We want it live with the April launch.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The plan cards stay the same: Starter at twelve dollars per user per month, Pro at twenty-nine, and Enterprise is contact sales.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Do we show annual pricing by default?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Yes, with a toggle for monthly. Annual shows the two months free badge.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's make sure the toggle state persists if someone navigates to the comparison table.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Noted. The comparison table is getting long, I'd like to collapse it into categories.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Agreed, with the top five features always visible.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Can we add a FAQ section? Sales gets the same five questions every week.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'll draft answers and send them to sales for a sanity check.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: We'll show euros and pounds based on location, using the prices already published in the help center.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: The design for mobile stacks the cards vertically with Pro highlighted.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: An A/B test on the button text. "Start free trial" versus "Try Pro free".

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay. Let's target staging by the end of next week.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'll have the copy final by Monday.

notes: Hard negative: public list prices on the pricing page, no margins or internal comp.
